apps.localizedDescription:
Features:

Camera.

• HEIF or Apple ProRAW at 12, 24 or 48 MP, as your device allows. 48 MP uses the main camera and switches lenses for .5× and telephoto automatically.
• A clean, familiar interface with Liquid Glass controls (iOS 26 and later; a material look on earlier versions).
• Zoom buttons and pinch to zoom, tap to focus and expose, flash, front and back cameras.
• With the back camera, the flash light blinks after every automatic photo, so the group knows it was taken (like Smart Take on iPhone Duo).
• Icons turn with your phone; the camera recovers cleanly from calls, FaceTime and Split View.
• On Mac: any built-in, external or iPhone camera. Press Space to start.

versions.localizedDescription:
The camera that waits for everyone. This update fixes the app icon: the corner brackets now show as thin, rounded brackets in both light and dark mode, as designed.

Download:

Mac: unzip, move SmartShot to Applications and open it. It is signed with a Developer ID and notarized by Apple, so it opens like any other app.

iPhone / iPad: install the .ipa with AltStore or Sideloadly, or build from source with Xcode.

What's new in 1.0.1:

• Fixed: the app icon's corner brackets were drawn as solid triangles.

SHA-256.

SmartShot is an independent project and is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Apple Inc.
